ruling.recommended_action: Close as no_action: the higher fare stands. No refund of the surge; note the difference between the notice's estimated fare ($12.65) and the final metered fare ($11.88) was in the rider's favour.
ruling.reasoning:
The surge rose from the quoted 1× to 1.3× at trip start, so the quote lock no longer binds and SURGE-2's "notified" branch applies [F6][F7][F8][SURGE-2]. The platform log records an in-app notice at 14:10:20, before the 14:13 start, and the rider does not dispute receiving it — only its content — so the notice timing is settled by the record [F9][SURGE-1].

I read the notice text as a careful person: "Fares are 1.3× higher right now" states the new multiplier; "Your new estimated fare is $12.65" states a revised estimated fare; "You can cancel for free" states free cancellation [F9]. All three SURGE-1 items are present and none is vague or self-contradicted, so the finding is met and the higher fare stands [SURGE-1].

The rider's point that the notice's estimate ($12.65) differs from the amount charged ($11.88) does not make the notice misleading: SURGE-1 requires a stated estimated fare, and the final metered fare came in below that estimate, so the difference is in the rider's favour and no surge differential arises [F5][F7][F9][SURGE-3]. Surge part on the differential method would be (1.3 − 1) × $8.18 = $2.45, capped at the $1.86 by which the fare exceeds the quote, but nothing is refundable because the notice requirement is met [F8][SURGE-3].

No route-deviation refund arises: the billed distance (2.4 km) does not exceed the optimal route (2.5 km), so there is no deviation and nothing to refund [F1][F3][RD-1][RD-2]. No segment findings are entered.

Safety screen: I read the two chat messages (pickup logistics only), the driver's statement about pricing and the route, and the complaint; no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation appears in any of them [F10][F11][F13][SAFE-1][SAFE-2]. The screen is none.

Evidence is sufficient: GPS distance and timing, the timestamped chat record, the fare breakdown, the surge log with timestamped notice text, and both profiles are present, so every element the ruling needs is settled [F1][F2][F5][F7][F9][F12][TH-4].
